title: feat(spec)!: key an object extension's fields by the field map's own key grammar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9MJTq8giFNFawGE7vvMCTA)_

Fixes #29523

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` ("Naming the fields you add") gains the key grammar. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` and its evals teach extension fields only as `region__c`, so every taught line stays true and no skill line changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对象扩展的 `fields`(扩展新增的字段)的键改用与对象 `fields`、扩展 `fieldPatches` 同一个键 schema(小写 snake_case),`Region Code`、`region-code` 这类对象自己的字段表不可能容纳的键在解析时就被拒,报一个带示例的 `invalid_key`。
- 为什么改:以前任何字符串都能过 schema。实测 main 上 `defineStack`、`os validate` 都放行;在 `.custom` 包里 `Region Code__c` 被保存门保存并发布、出现在每个对象读取里、启动重读照样注册,还按这个名字建列存了值。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING,spec minor,ADR-0087 语义迁移条目已登记,`os migrate meta --stored` 会列出存量坏键行)。仓内 examples/skills/docs/模板无一处写过这种键;已存储的带坏键的扩展行升级后整行不再注册(其 `fieldPatches` 一并),再保存被 422 拒,直到改名。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`(`ObjectExtensionSchema.fields` 的键 schema 与 `invalid_key` 文案)、`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`(新检测器)、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-key-grammar-refused.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-customization.test.ts src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件全绿(192 条)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: `ObjectExtensionSchema.fields` is keyed by `FieldNameKeySchema`, the one key schema `ObjectSchema.fields` and `ObjectExtensionSchema.fieldPatches` already read (not exported; its doc comment now lists all three readers). The record's error map answers `invalid_key` with a prescription: the key is the name of a field the extension adds, lowercase snake_case such as `region_code` (`region_code__c` in a customization package), never its label. The issue sits at `fields.KEY`, as the `fieldPatches` one sits at `fieldPatches.KEY`. The `fields` describe names the grammar. `__proto__` stays refused on the raw input by `refuseRecordProtoKey`, unchanged.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`: one detector, `object-extension-field-key-grammar-refused`, appended after the `fieldPatches` one. Its predicate is the refusing door's own: `ObjectExtensionSchema.safeParse`, keeping each `invalid_key` issue at `fields.KEY` (the `fieldPatches` reader and this one now share one helper, `refusedExtensionRecordKeys(extension, slot)`). It lists, never rewrites, names the target, shows only the key and the field's `type` in `from`, and closes each reason with the parse's own message.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-key-grammar-refused.ts`: the ADR-0087 semantic entry (refused, with a prescription; no conversion, because the key is the name a field is stored and read under, and a respelling names a different column or lands on a field the target already declares).
- `.changeset/29523-object-extension-field-key-grammar.md`: spec `minor`, BREAKING, `adr-0087: registered object-extension-field-key-grammar-refused`, with the FROM → TO line.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`: one paragraph in "Naming the fields you add". `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`: regenerated (the `fields` describe moved).
- No public export is added or removed. No existing test or fixture needed an edit: every extension `fields` key in `examples/**`, `skills/**`, `content/docs/**`, templates and test fixtures is already snake_case.

## Why — the measurement that chose the declaration

Measured on `origin/main` `1c1a5d40` (spec built from main's `object.zod.ts`), then on this branch:

| Door | `main` | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ObjectExtensionSchema` / `defineObjectExtension` (`fields: { 'Region Code': … }`) | parses | one `invalid_key` at `fields.Region Code` |
| `defineStack({ objectExtensions })`, target outside the stack | accepted | refused, `objectExtensions.0.fields.Region Code` |
| `defineStack`, target inside the stack | accepted (the merged object is not re-parsed) | refused |
| `os validate` (CLI on a scratch `defineStack` config) | no issue on the extension (only an unrelated `security-owd-unset` on the scratch object) | exit 1, both extension keys named |
| `object_extension` save + publish door, `.custom` pair, key `Region Code__c` | stored and published; served on the by-name, list, layered and registry reads; a record insert stored `EMEA` under `Region Code__c`; a boot re-read (`loadMetaFromDb`) registered it again with 0 errors | save refused 422 `INVALID_METADATA`, issue `invalid_key` at `fields.Region Code__c`; no row stored; insert refused `INVALID_FIELD` |
| A row stored before the upgrade, re-read at boot | n/a | `loadMetaFromDb` counts 1 error, the extension is not registered (no extender), and its re-save is refused 422 |

So every authoring door accepted such a key end to end, which makes this `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, BREAKING, with the semantic entry and the `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector the card asks for (the stored pass reaches `object_extension` rows since #29589).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.test.ts` gains the describe "extension `fields` keys — the field map's own key grammar" (8 cases): `Region Code`, `RegionCode`, `region-code`, `2nd_phone`, `Region Code__c` each refused with exactly one `invalid_key` at `fields.KEY` (message names the grammar and an example, no tracker id); CONTROL `region_code` and `region_code__c` parse; CONTROL both authored examples of the object-extension guide parse whole; and an agreement test that the extension `fields` record refuses at the key exactly the keys `ObjectSchema.fields` refuses at the key, over an 11-key sample that holds keys on both sides (guarded against vacuity).
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`: the registered id list gains the new id last; one TODO per refused key at `objectExtensions[0].fields.KEY`, the row unchanged; the listed keys equal the parse's `invalid_key` issues and each reason ends with the parse's message; snake_case keys (`__c` included) are not listed and parse; and a row with both a bad `fields` key and a bad `fieldPatches` key is listed once by each detector, never crossed.

## Acceptance notes

- Not changed here: the manifest fold (`ObjectQL.registerApp`, the `objectExtensions` branch in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`) copies `ext.fields` as given and parses nothing; measured on this branch, `registerApp` with `fields: { 'Region Code': … }` still registers the field and stores a value. Every authoring path that produces a manifest (`defineStack`, `os validate`, `os build`, the save door) now refuses the key first, so only an artifact built before the upgrade reaches it. That is the fold's trust model for every collection, not this card's; noted, not filed.
- Not changed here, same family: `ObjectSchema.fields` refuses `constructor` and `prototype` by record refines that sit outside the key schema, so `ObjectExtensionSchema.fields: { constructor: … }` still parses (as `fieldPatches: { constructor: … }` does, noted on #29513). Noted, not filed.

## Verification

All readings on objectstack-ai/objectstack, head `bd50ef25` (merge of `origin/main` `87956dcc`; the delta against main is the eight files listed above).

<details><summary>Door probes (scratch, not committed)</summary>

A throwaway copy of the `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` rig (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`, real `ObjectQL`, real protocol), run once against a spec dist built from main's `object.zod.ts` and once against this branch's; and `os validate` on a scratch `defineStack` config in `packages/cli`. Readings are the table above. The probe files were deleted before commit.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the new tests can fail</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `z.record(FieldNameKeySchema, FieldSchema, {` with `z.record(z.string(), FieldSchema, {` in `object.zod.ts` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `06e35bf5` → `09e91a78`) and ran `src/data/field-customization.test.ts src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`: 9 failed | 183 passed (192). The five refusal cases, the agreement test and the three new listing tests went red; every control stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec suite imports `./object.zod` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run. Taken on `61876fc4`; the tested lines did not change in the merge.
</details>

<details><summary>Spec and consumer packages (downstream of the contract)</summary>

Under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

On the final head `bd50ef25`, after a full `turbo run build --concurrency=2` (117/117 tasks):
- `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated`: exit 0. `test`: 803/803 files, 23807 passed | 1 todo.
- `@objectstack/organizations` `object-extension-managed-target.wall.test.ts`: 1/1, 5 tests. `@objectstack/plugin-auth` `identity-objects-plugin.test.ts`: 1/1, 15. `@objectstack/plugin-security` `upgrade-impact-report.wiring.test.ts`: 1/1, 5.
- `@objectstack/downstream-contract` test: 3/3, 31. `@objectstack/example-showcase` test: 45/45, 541.

On `61876fc4` (before the main merge; spec built from this branch):
- `@objectstack/spec` `test`: 803/803 files, 23798 passed | 1 todo. `typecheck`: exit 0. `test:repo`: 89/89, 1522.
- `@objectstack/metadata-core` (full): 23/23, 904. `@objectstack/objectql` (full): 544/544, 10606. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (full): 308 passed | 4 skipped (312), 22262 passed | 26 skipped.
- Every other test file outside `packages/spec` that names `objectExtensions`, `defineObjectExtension`, `object_extension` or `ObjectExtensionSchema`: `@objectstack/cli` 9/9 (108), `@objectstack/cloud-connection` 3/3 (19), `@objectstack/lint` 7/7 (535), `@objectstack/metadata` 2/2 (17), `@objectstack/platform-objects` 2/2 (73), `@objectstack/rest` 5/5 (81), `@objectstack/runtime` 4/4 (48).
- Not run locally: the three `ui/packages/app-shell` files that name an extension (`ResourceListPage.objectExtensionName-29569`, `DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575`, `DataPillar.draftUnreadable-29148`). Their extension bodies are mock-server fixtures keyed `custom_note__c`, `budget_code__c`, `region__c`, `tier__c`, and none parses them with the spec; Test UI runs them. Studio's add-field derives the name through `toFieldNameLoose` and `extensionFieldName`, so it writes snake_case keys.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head `bd50ef25`: 104 commands, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 104 derived, 104 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. They ran after the full build, so the built-output gates (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`) measured, where on `61876fc4` they had exited 3 for want of that build. `check-adr-0087-registration` (registered, new here) and `check-changeset-no-major` are among the 104.
</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood (narrowing arm, final head)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock on `bd50ef25`, after the full build in the same locked run: 402 passed | 3 skipped (405) files; 3317 passed | 28 skipped (3345) tests; exit 0, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
